title: China–Soviet/Russian border negotiation moves and obligation stages
scope: 1986/1987 background through October 14, 2008 implementation; source availability as of research date, not a comprehensive 2026 border-status audit.
coding_rules: Separate claimed territory, actual control, legal delimitation, ratification, field demarcation and access.
An explicit reservation is part of the bargain, not inferred nonperformance.
Agreement and handover do not identify causal motive or bargaining skill.
Reported arguments remain attributed; no uniform Russian or Chinese interest is presumed.
Full S-P24 combines concrete drafting and senior intervention. S-P25 arena evidence does not automatically establish asymmetric demands.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Iwashita traces reopening in February 1987 after Vladivostok initiative and reports renewed convergence around constructive 1964 results.
moves.obligation_or_position: Attribution includes main-channel approach with particular unresolved exceptions.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: Substantive convergence predates 1989; formal agreement followed in 1991.
moves.inference_limit: Source is retrospective scholarship drawing on participant memoirs, not recovered 1987 instructions or complete offers.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Joint communiqué seeks simultaneous resolution of eastern and western sectors and authorizes foreign-minister talks.
moves.obligation_or_position: Simultaneous objective stated in contemporary Chinese and English publications.
moves.inference_limit: Does not prove every Chinese offer required indivisible package or identify motive for later separation. Parent primary audit supplies precise scope.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Signed eastern boundary agreement; Article III reserves points 7–8 and 10–11.
moves.obligation_or_position: Equal joint commission, channel criteria, field documents and maps; specified navigation provisions.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: Effective March 16, 1992; implementation followed for covered sections while reserved islands remained.
moves.inference_limit: Coordinate Article II only partially read, original maps missing. Claim settlement does not establish new physical control at every island.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Official Chinese treaty metadata/editorial note dates effectiveness.
moves.obligation_or_position: 1991 eastern treaty operative after ratification exchange.
moves.inference_limit: Effective date does not itself mean all marking or handover completed. No five-year sunset in provisions read.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Signed eight-article western-sector agreement.
moves.obligation_or_position: Equal commission; actual watershed determination; separate three-party junction arrangement with Kazakhstan.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: Western boundary handled separately from remaining eastern islands.
moves.inference_limit: Complete signed Russian body read, map and exact entry-into-force date not verified.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Iwashita reconstructs Primorye resistance, Rozov resignation and federal/local negotiations over demarcation.
moves.obligation_or_position: Local security and economic interests advanced as reasons to resist or modify practical arrangements.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: Accommodation and 1997 completion announcement for 1991-covered sections.
moves.inference_limit: Not all governors shared one position. Iwashita expiry argument unverified and excluded from causal coding.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Iwashita attributes proposal for continuing traditional use under Chinese sovereignty to Russian local/border authorities.
moves.obligation_or_position: Separate sovereignty from bounded local economic access.
moves.inference_limit: Origin story remains scholarship-based; contemporaneous Chinese instructions not acquired.

moves.stage: covered-sector completion and guiding use agreement
moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Iwashita describes completion of demarcation for 1991-covered sections and guiding joint-use accord.
moves.obligation_or_position: Outstanding islands remain reserved; guiding framework enables traditional local use.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: Boundary description and detailed use agreement signed December 9, 1999.
moves.inference_limit: Not completion of entire Sino-Russian boundary. Full 1997 guiding text absent; existence also referenced in 1999 preamble.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Sign reciprocal local economic use agreement alongside boundary-description protocol referenced in its preamble.
moves.obligation_or_position: Sovereign permission for established foreign local users; restricted activities, nonincreasing users, permits, host law, inspections and at least twice-yearly consultation; five-year use period with dates diplomatically agreed.
moves.inference_limit: Complete published twelve-article body read; two annexes absent. Neither actual user numbers nor actual later expiration established.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Sign friendship treaty; Article 6 states no mutual territorial claims while acknowledging unagreed boundary alignments.
moves.obligation_or_position: Continue negotiation and maintain status quo until settlement; regular contacts and existing security arrangements.
moves.inference_limit: No-mutual-claims clause cannot be isolated to infer all territorial alignment already settled.

actors: Khabarovsk, Chita and Jewish Autonomous Region executives
moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Presidential order 479-rp approves coordinated proposal and attached drafts; delegates negotiation/signature and nonprincipled changes.
moves.obligation_or_position: Specific boundary draft, navigation protocol draft and existing-agreements memorandum draft.
moves.inference_limit: Private legal reproduction of primary order; Chinese mandate not available. Order date alone does not establish contemporary outside accessibility or predictive usefulness.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Sign supplementary boundary agreement with coordinates through Abagaitui and Bolshoi Ussuriisky.
moves.obligation_or_position: Equal joint commission to determine exact channels/islands, erect markers and produce maps; permanent boundary despite natural changes except agreement.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: Ratified 2005; final descriptive protocol and handover 2008.
moves.inference_limit: Published schematics show claims and settlement, not original 1:100,000 treaty maps. Area labels 335/62 km² describe entire disputed regions, not Chinese awards.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Signed memorandum extends existing bilateral border cooperation agreements to newly delimited sections after boundary agreement effectiveness.
moves.obligation_or_position: Existing cooperation regime made applicable to new jurisdictional areas.
moves.inference_limit: Final memorandum acquired; Russian navigation draft only anticipates future agreement, not final regime proof.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Joint statement presents boundary result as balanced and beneficial to strategic partnership/local cooperation.
moves.obligation_or_position: Jointly announced objectives coexist with other economic and security priorities.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: Ratification and field demarcation still required.
moves.inference_limit: Co-location with energy and WTO announcements does not establish particular quid pro quo or private motive.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Original reporting records legislative opposition, governor defense of retained local interests, protests and uneven access to agreement detail.
moves.obligation_or_position: Competing interpretations of local economic/security costs and legitimacy.
moves.inference_limit: Reported public claims and estimated protest numbers, not independent legal adjudication or representative opinion measurement.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: NPC Standing Committee approves supplementary agreement signed by Li Zhaoxing.
moves.obligation_or_position: Domestic approval recorded in Gazette and Xinhua reproduction.
moves.inference_limit: Xinhua release May 27 is not the decision date; no internal debate recovered.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Kommersant reports 307–80 vote, agency disagreements over local threat and explanations of compromise.
moves.obligation_or_position: Public defense of settlement emphasizes legal clarification and retained interests; competing threat claims aired.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: Federation Council May 25, presidential law May 31.
moves.inference_limit: Journalist report not complete official stenogram; force and channel-manipulation claims unverified.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Russian law records Council approval May 25 and Putin signature May 31; Chinese treaty publication dates effectiveness June 2.
moves.obligation_or_position: Supplementary agreement legally operative; memorandum likewise effective.
moves.inference_limit: Entry into force distinct from physical handover; full ratification-exchange record not independently acquired.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Official report records supplementary descriptive protocol and annex signatures, completion of field demarcation and domestic procedures still pending.
moves.obligation_or_position: Government approval and exchange of notes to complete legal implementation step.
moves.implementation_or_subsequent_record: October 14 exchange of notes and ceremony.
moves.inference_limit: Complete protocol and annexes absent; announcement does not independently inspect all pillars.

moves.observed_or_attributed_move: Chinese transcript records exchange of notes and boundary-marker ceremony; original reporting corroborates Tarabarov/Yinlong and western Bolshoi Ussuriisky handover.
moves.obligation_or_position: 2008 descriptive protocol and annexes effective.
moves.inference_limit: English transcript mistranslates title as Supplementary Agreement: do not conflate with 2004 instrument. RFA media-exclusion claim attributed to Russian media, not direct independent verification.
